notes: Protocol: the supplied brief_v05.md, both witness texts, C_alerts.md, PREAMBLE.tex, notation_snapshot.md and source_paths.json were read. The whole scan was opened once for layout, then half_a once and half_b once in that order. No OCR, text recognition, PDF text layer, research, other scan, another reader material, records directory, or delegation was used.

Timing: start_utc is the first clock value actually logged, after initial brief/input reading and before image viewing; it is not a fabricated earlier invocation time. Whole/half timestamps were sampled immediately before each view. Crop inspection timestamps identify the start of a sequential inspection batch; three-image batches are not falsely assigned separate exact times.

Coverage: every text block, every word and ending, accent, abbreviation, punctuation mark, and every inline/display expression was compared against both witnesses, including their agreements. The bottom cancelled text was read in full. All arrows, underlines, insertions, overtyping, and both numbering positions were inventoried. This coverage statement is separate from proof checking.

The sheet is a typescript with pen additions/corrections and a separate lower-left pencil 5. Personal authorship of the pen or pencil is not established by this packet, so the inventory uses unnamed hand. No title, date, salutation, letterhead, stamp, independent drawing, or separate diagram was found. The opening Hom arrow is a displayed formula; the two insertion connectors are attached insertion hooks, not detached figures.

The opening text says that the displayed map between the two Hom categories is an isomorphism of categories and explains the superscript S by a full subcategory of tensor functors taking the named objects to invertibles. This is a statement transcribed from the page, not a theorem verified in this run.

The writer says that the construction is natural but declines to spell out its long compatibility checks. For S equal to all objects, the text calls the result the catégorie de Picard enveloppante, and assigns K^0 and K^1 notation to the first two invariants. The degree corrections have been preserved as ink layers rather than normalized away.

The projective-module example identifies the invariants with the named classical groups and the next sentence tentatively extends the same result to every additive category: sans doute is retained. The inserted phrase avec l’opération de somme, is typed, while its attachment connector is pen; the origin of the connector has not been transferred to the word.

The discussion of a canonical chain complex is qualified by semblent rendre peu probable. It mentions H_0 and H_1 values and the theory of Deligne. This argument was not independently proved, refuted, or used in another derivation here. Merely checking the glyphs and indices is not logged as a mathematical event.

The final live paragraph proposes a geometric interpretation of higher invariants in n-categories of Picard, again with prospective language Il y a tout lieu de croire. Its first occurrence is literally interpétation, without the r after p, whereas the later occurrence is interprétation. The live final word is broken as obligerai- at this scan edge; no unseen continuation has been supplied.

The final three-line paragraph is cancelled by a large pen enclosure/through-line and broad oblique curved strokes. Its full legible wording is included in deleted, including the older doubtful dans beneath autre. The last visible word is cut as néces-. H’s editorial note is credited for the outer cancellation; it is not treated as omitted content or as a doubt flag.

All eight explicit C doubt loci are accounted for: upper 5, old P|F, old le, old upper K digit, punctuation after somme), old est, pair after à, and old dans. The old upper digit is reordered 1|0 on the basis of straight surviving strokes, and comma/stop is reordered ,|. on shape. The other C doubts are retained because their crops do not resolve the obscured forms. A new apostrophe/point doubt is introduced for the separate high mark after stricte).

The C alerts about Hom underlines/alphabet, raised later K degrees, low H indices and complex dots, the dotted i positions, AUC order, the comma in que, cette, and plain chaines were checked. Nothing on this page supplies an accent over the i of chaines. No comparison of earlier or later page images was made.

Differences already settled by a supplied half are labelled as such in changes and have no reader crop. The main reader must make and personally inspect its adjudication crop for these loci. No settled place was recropped. There are twelve tight crops, one per locally unresolved/crowded locus; c10 settled an agreement concerning typed-word versus pen-connector origin.

Equivalent H macro syntax is not counted as a reading difference. H’s struck et plus added avec is credited as the same deletion/replacement; the x cancellation mask itself is preserved in reading.tex. Its emph words match the underlined spans. Absent generic handwriting wrappers in H are not by themselves origin differences. H’s page 5 is credited for the archive number; the upper-number row concerns the lack of source uncertainty, not a duplicate archive-number omission.
No mathematical checks were performed beyond visual transcription and formula-structure inspection, so math_checks is empty. No claim on the page has been represented as independently verified.
